LanguageData.VGE_NoPain.label: no pain sensitivity
LanguageData.VGE_NoPain.description: This creature has a reduced pain sensitivity, and it takes longer to be downed due to pain.
LanguageData.VGE_ExowormInfestation.label: exoworm infestation
LanguageData.VGE_ExowormInfestation.description: Parasitic exoworm larvae burrowing and growing within the flesh. As it matures, it will consume local tissue and cause extreme pain. Without aggressive treatment and a strong immune response, the worm will eventually erupt from the body part.
LanguageData.VGE_ExowormInfestation.comps.3.discoverL: {0} has been infected with exoworm larva. They need immediate and constant medical care, or the worm will eventually crawl out of them.
